Name: Monster spawner
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
[b][size=5]Mobs Spawner[/size][/b]
[heading]Description[/heading]
Want to bring your favorite monsters directly to your farm?
[b]Monster Summoner[/b] is a simple and lightweight cheat mod that lets you choose a monster through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] and spawn it near your player with a single key press.
Choose your monster once, return to the game, and press the configured hotkey whenever you want to summon one. Every press spawns [b]exactly one monster[/b], giving you complete control over how many you want to encounter.
Whether you want to create your own monster battles, test combat builds, collect monster drops, or simply cause some chaos on your farm, Monster Summoner gives you an easy way to do it.
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]🐲 Choose the monster to summon through [b]GMCM[/b] [/*]
[*]⌨️ Configurable hotkey for spawning [/*]
[*]👾 Spawn [b]one monster per key press[/b] [/*]
[*]📍 Monsters appear safely near the player [/*]
[*]⚔️ Monsters keep their normal vanilla combat behavior [/*]
[*]🎁 Normal monster loot and XP are preserved [/*]
[*]🌱 Designed for farm gameplay [/*]
[*]⚡ Lightweight and easy to use [/*]
[*]🔧 No complicated menus or commands required [/*]
[/list][heading]How It Works[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Open [b]GMCM[/b]. [/*]
[*]Select the monster you want to spawn. [/*]
[*]Set your preferred hotkey. [/*]
[*]Return to the game. [/*]
[*]Press the hotkey. [/*]
[*]One selected monster appears near you. [/*]
[/list]Press the key again to spawn another.
For example:
[quote][b]Monster:[/b] Green Slime
[b]Press key:[/b] → 1 Green Slime appears
[b]Press again:[/b] → another Green Slime appears[/quote]You control the number of monsters simply by controlling how many times you press the key.
[heading]Monster Selection[/heading]
The mod supports a variety of Stardew Valley monsters, including common enemies such as Slimes, Bats, Serpents, Shadow creatures, Skeletons, Ghosts, and other supported monster types.
The available list is designed around monsters that can be safely created and spawned using Stardew Valley's current 1.6 systems.
[heading]Vanilla Behavior[/heading]
Spawned monsters retain their normal behavior and properties.
This means the mod does not intentionally modify:
[list]
[*]Health [/*]
[*]Damage [/*]
[*]Movement [/*]
[*]AI [/*]
[*]Attack behavior [/*]
[*]Loot [/*]
[*]Combat XP [/*]
[/list]The mod simply gives you control over [b]when and what monster appears[/b].
[heading]Controls[/heading]
[b]Default Spawn Key:[/b]
[code]F7[/code]The hotkey can be changed through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].
The key only works during normal gameplay and does not interfere with inventory, shops, dialogue, or other menus.
